title: EMOGen: Enhancing Mask Optimization via Pattern Generation
problem: Existing layout pattern generation methods target optical proximity correction (OPC) improvement but are not explicitly trained for OPC nor integrated into OPC methods, limiting their practical effectiveness in semiconductor manufacturing.
motivation: Layout pattern generation via deep generative models is essential for building large-scale pattern libraries in semiconductor fabrication.
method: EMOGen works by having two AI systems improve each other. One generates new semiconductor layout patterns using deep generative models (AI systems trained to create new designs), while the other applies learning-based OPC (optical proximity correction—a technique that learns to adjust patterns so they print correctly when manufactured). Rather than optimizing these separately, the system takes turns: the pattern generator creates layouts, OPC refines them, and that feedback helps the generator create better layouts next time. This cycle repeats, so both systems improve together because each learns from what the other needs.
key_novelty: Instead of optimizing pattern generation and OPC correction separately, EMOGen trains them together in a co-evolutionary cycle so improvements in each directly help the other.
contributions: EMOGen framework for co-evolution of layout pattern generation and OPC
primary_theme: Co-evolutionary optimization of layout patterns and OPC
